name: The Necklace of Blood
source:
Based on the novel "El Collar de Sangre" by German Ramos Briñez, The Necklace of Blood is a two parts thriller visual novel.

The necklace of blood is a jewel which many would give their lives for, they don’t imagine the power and responsibility of owning it. The necklace has been cursed and bathed in the blood of Satan himself, the necklace was consecrated on the altars of death to cause the madness of men.

The evil one has sent a powerful Jackal to this dimension, his son, to be confused among men.

The mission of the Jackal is to enforce a prophecy written more than 200 years ago, which points to the moral and religious destruction of a great metropolis, New York.

To fulfill the objective, the Jackal recruits men, in different ways, and turns them into vassals at the service of darkness, to spread the plague.

An old secret organization, called "The Council", fights against the power of the Devil, and tries by all means to end the word of evil, written in black books.

This is the story of one of those men, manipulated by the black light of death, which induces him to become a vassal and commits him to the ultimate consequences.

It is a journey that will take emotions to the limit and make you reflect on the behavior of people in an environment dominated by vanity and consumerism, where moral values are a facade and ethics is a price as solid as personal convenience.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/792760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《血之项链》根据赫尔曼·拉莫斯·布里涅斯的小说《El Collar de Sangre》改编，是一部分为两部分的惊悚视觉小说。

血之项链是一件许多人愿意为之献出生命的珠宝，但他们并不知道拥有它意味着力量与责任。项链受到了诅咒，浸泡在撒旦本人的鲜血中，并在死亡祭坛上举行了祝圣仪式，用以使人疯狂。

邪恶者将一只强大的豺狼派往这个次元——那是他的儿子，伪装在人群之中。

豺狼的使命是执行一项写于200多年前的预言：某座大都市将遭受道德与宗教毁灭，而那座城市正是纽约。

为实现目标，豺狼以各种方式招募男人，将他们变成黑暗的仆从，传播瘟疫。

一个名为“议会”的古老秘密组织与恶魔的力量斗争，竭尽全力终结写在黑色书籍中的邪恶之词。

这是其中一名男人的故事：他被死亡的黑光操纵，成为仆从，并被推向最终后果。

这是一段把情感推至极限的旅程，也会让你思考人类在虚荣与消费主义支配的环境中的行为；在那里，道德价值只是表面，伦理则是和个人便利一样坚硬的价格。
